verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server explicitly enabling developers to 'use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster,' which is direct evidence of agentic/natural-language operability. However, the evidence is a single doc reference with no detail on scope of supported commands, no independent hands-on verification, and no broader natural-language control surface beyond this MCP integration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what actions the MCP server exposes, independent/hands-on validation of natural-language workflows, and broader agentic tooling beyond the MCP server.
